The trusted operating‑benchmark source states that corporate lodging agreements set a maximum nightly rate of **$550**. For standard conference‑district hotels, no extra approvals are needed as long as the rate stays at or below that cap.  

**Therefore, you may book rooms up to $550 per night without further approval.** If you need a room that costs more than $550 per night, you would have to obtain additional approval first.
